title: tier-2 shipped code: the segment's AABB corners in a matrix frame, 0x142697ac0
notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-sim/src/aabb.rs (segment_aabb_transform), called through the probe's segment_aabb_transform entry.

Read from the body, not the C: c = (high+low)*0.5 and e = (high-low)*0.5 on all four lanes; ext = (e.y*|m1| + e.x*|m0|) + e.z*|m2|; cen = ((c.x*m0 + t) + c.y*m1) + c.z*m2; out[0..4] = cen - ext, out[4..8] = cen + ext.

The extent's add order is the client's: the 0x55 broadcast (lane 1) is multiplied first (0x142697b0c), the 0x00 broadcast (lane 0) second (0x142697b19), and the two are added (0x142697b27) before the 0xaa term (0x142697b3b). The centre adds t before the y and z terms (0x142697b46, 0x142697b4a, 0x142697b4d).
The two constants are image data: 0x142f844e0 is 0.5 four times, 0x142f7aaf0 is 0x7fffffff four times (andps abs mask). Lane 3 is computed, never masked off.
coverageThreshold is 0 because the body has no conditional branch: the ladder's coverage stage finds no site to sweep, which is why the differential and mutation stages carry this unit.

NaN *inputs* are excluded: where the body meets two NaNs the emulator clears the sign of the one it returns (0x7fc00001 whichever operand carries it, measured with m0[0] = 0xffc00001 and 0x7fc00001), while subps/addps keep the destination's NaN. +-inf inputs do agree and are covered.
acknowledgedGaps: The client returns its first argument in rax (mov rax, rcx at 0x142697acc, never overwritten). The Rust entry returns nothing and the harness compares the 32-byte output buffer; a pointer return cannot be compared across the two address frames.
The caller-facing meaning of the two endpoints is not read: the body only needs them as low/high 4-wide values, and lane 3 participates, so a caller's use of lane 3 is open.

Two-NaN operands cannot be compared across the two engines: the oracle's softfloat returns a sign-cleared NaN regardless of which operand carries it, the instruction returns the destination's. Measured 2026-11-20; a NaN reaching this function is already a broken position, so no gameplay path depends on it.
